_meta.description: REQ-CPA-006 / REQ-CPA-007: consume OpenRegister's calendar and contacts integration leaves. Declares configuration.linkedTypes only on the four schemas that carry none in the merged register: VatReturn and ARInvoice get the calendar leaf (a per-object view of the deadline events ComplianceDeadlineCalendarService already publishes; no second publisher), CustomerMaster and Payee get the contacts leaf (match and link one address-book contact per object, no bulk export). Invoice (mail) and Contract (decidesk-decisions) are not touched: SettingsService::deepMergeConfig() concatenates list arrays, so restating them here would duplicate their entries. Sorts last (zzz- prefix) so every fragment defining these schemas is merged before it.
